# Generated by iptables-save v1.8.9 on Tue May 19 09:00:00 2026
# A sloppy edge router, for the linter: INPUT default-denies but forgot the
# conntrack ESTABLISHED rule (drops replies to its own outbound connections)
# and never logs what it drops, FORWARD keeps policy ACCEPT with no catch-all
# (it routes anything), and the MASQUERADE has no source restriction (it NATs
# anything the box forwards, not just the LAN it was meant for). The LAN_TRUST
# chain was written but nobody ever wired it in — its ACCEPT never runs. The
# MASQUERADE appears twice: the rc.local script appends it on every boot.
# And the 8080 port-forward was added in a hurry with neither -d nor -i —
# every host the router forwards for gets its port 8080 hijacked, LAN
# clients included, not just traffic arriving on the public interface.
# The second 8443 accept "throttles brute force" with plain -m limit: one
# token bucket shared by every client, so an attacker draining it locks
# the legitimate admin out of the web UI too.
# The web server's SYN-flood protection came straight from a tutorial with
# -j DROP on the -m limit line: the bucket points the wrong way, so the rule
# discards the first 25 SYN/s — calm, legitimate visitors — and once the
# bucket runs dry the real flood sails past it into the ACCEPT below.
# The SMTP "guard" is the half-fix of that same recipe: someone flipped the
# matcher to --hashlimit-above (per source, even) but left -j ACCEPT, so it
# admits only the traffic ABOVE 10/s — quiet mail is dead, floods get in.
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:LAN_TRUST - [0:0]
-A LAN_TRUST -s 192.168.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -s 10.0.0.0/8 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -m mac --mac-source AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -m limit --limit 10/min -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 --tcp-flags FIN,SYN,RST,ACK SYN -m limit --limit 25/sec --limit-burst 100 -j DROP
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 25 -m hashlimit --hashlimit-above 10/sec --hashlimit-mode srcip --hashlimit-name smtpguard -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -s 169.254.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p icmp -j ACCEPT
COMMIT
*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8080 -j DNAT --to-destination 192.168.1.50:8080
-A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
-A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
COMMIT
